title: Enochian tale found in Dead Sea Scroll manuscripts
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Enochian tale found in Dead Sea Scroll manuscripts, about Second Temple period at Qumran, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the Enochian tale is attested not just in Enoch >> but in several Dead Sea Scroll manuscripts >> including the book of giants

plain: A researcher and filmmaker named Tim Alberino says the old story told in the Book of Enoch, an ancient Jewish text about fallen angels and the giants they fathered, does not appear only in that one book. He says it also shows up in several of the Dead Sea Scrolls, ancient manuscripts found near Qumran, including one called the Book of Giants. To him, this means the tale was widely known and taken seriously in ancient times.
